Role: You are a front end developer developing a web app  Goal: To create a platform that motivates people to pick up hobbies and skill sets in their free time based on a customised plan, with insights from their social media likes, bookmarks, resources and for users to find their tribes and share spaces, resources, tips, guides.  Output: The app should have a map interface to allow users to find fellow HobbyMates in real time. There should be progress tracking to allow users to see how they compare to others relatively and how they can level up.   Guardrails: Simple, clean, chat-based, organic interaction. Not overwhelming visual, no information overload.  Context: Refer to the CSV file attached as a guideline on the ideas that has been discussed before.

Key problem statement
What are we trying to solve?
hobby coach/ mentor
people think they have no time for hobbies
no idea of what hobbies to go into
short-lived interests
distractions, too many interest at the same time
no community, no bouncing board, no common topic with current friends/family
cost that goes into a hobbies, becomes a barrier, without knowing if you would like it
Overwhelmed by the choices, reviews, information
lack personalised guidance on steps, situation
Lower barriers to entry of starting a hobby by building a community of people with similar interests to offer guidance and support
Make people act on their interest instead of just living the experience through others, by providing personalised guidance and a way to track progress
To create a platform for people to discover interests, find a community and have create a personalised actionable plan that integrates hobbies and interests into a sustainable lifestyle
An AI-powered personal hobby mentor that makes learning new hobbies easier, more affordable, and personalized for everyone
Bridge the gap between people's interest in learning and their ability to actually develop a skill, creating an opportunity for an affordable coaching service.
